Dear [Client Name], I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform needed formal certification from the vendor, and that certification process has taken longer than anticipated, pushing our overall schedule back by two weeks.

We understand that timing matters for your own planning, so would you like to set up a short call this week to walk through the revised schedule and confirm it still fits your launch plans. We will continue sending you progress updates as the integration moves through its final steps. Best regards, [Your Name]
